description: Returns one file from a site you can update, as utf8 text or base64. site is the address. path is the file. A site token for that site works, including before the site is claimed, the same way an update with that token does. Without a token, claim the site first. Read-only. No money. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

path.description: The file, for example index.html or css/site.css.

site.description: The address of the site (from list_sites).

site_id.description: With site_token and no account: the site id from the publish reply.

site_token.description: That site token, from the publish reply.

name: get_site_file
